Weddings

Your day,
timeless

From the quiet moments before the ceremony to the last dance, GodFadaVisuals covers your pre-wedding shoot and wedding day with a calm, unobtrusive approach — so the photos feel like the day actually did.

01

Studio Pre-Wedding

An intimate, controlled-light session in studio — clean backdrops, editorial posing, perfect for save-the-date visuals.

02

Outdoor Pre-Wedding

Golden-hour locations around Port Harcourt, multiple outfit changes, and a relaxed, cinematic feel for your engagement story.

03

Full Coverage

Traditional and white wedding coverage available on request — reach out on WhatsApp to discuss a custom package for your date.

Book a Shoot

3 quick steps · Less than 3 minutes

We'll send you a little something on your birthday.
Step 1 of 3

Studio policy

Full payment required. Non-refundable. Cancellations must be made 48 hours before the shoot. Edited photos delivered within 3 working days. Express delivery (24hrs) = ₦8,000. Extra edits = ₦6,500/image. Raw files are not released.

Outdoor policy

Full payment required. Non-refundable. Cancellations 48 hours before shoot. Location fee not included. Delivery within 4–5 working days. Express delivery (24hrs) = ₦13,000. Extra edits = ₦10,000/image. Raw files are not released.

Lateness policy

Please arrive on time for your scheduled shoot. Lateness attracts an additional charge of ₦10,000.

Image usage & privacy

All photos taken by GodFadaVisuals remain the intellectual property of GodFadaVisuals and may be used for portfolio, social media, and promotional purposes. This is standard industry practice — your images help us showcase our craft and attract new clients.

If you require full confidentiality and wish to restrict all usage of your images, a Private Session Fee applies on top of your shoot package. This must be discussed and agreed upon in writing before your shoot date. To enquire about private session pricing, contact us directly on WhatsApp before booking.
